name: VMware Certified Implementation Expert - Data Center Virtualization
name_ja: VMware認定実装エキスパート（データセンター仮想化）

logistics.format: Awarded after passing both VCAP-DCV Design and VCAP-DCV Deploy proctored exams (Pearson VUE)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded design-and-deploy practical pathway after VCP supports expert infrastructure responsibility at five years; general virtualization and vendor scope do not establish dedicated cybersecurity expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Both advanced design and deployment assessments, including hands-on performance, support expert virtualization implementation at the five-year profile. The aggregate credential remains vendor-specific and does not alone establish broad security architecture leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded design and deployment examinations provide strong practical breadth beyond an active base credential. A five-year profile supports professional infrastructure delivery, but no expert peer defense or equivalent senior assessment is documented.
